+"""Transaction cost & slippage model shared by all three backtest loops.
+
+Three modes, selected via ``CostModel.mode``:
+  - "none"       — zero cost. ``equity == equity_gross`` always.
+  - "flat"       — today's legacy behavior: a flat per-day haircut applied
+                   whenever the portfolio holds any position, independent of
+                   how much actually turned over. Kept so every existing
+                   backtest result stays reproducible bit-for-bit; this is
+                   the default mode everywhere.
+  - "realistic"  — commission + half bid-ask spread + square-root market
+                   impact, charged on TURNOVER (|Δweight| × equity), not a
+                   flat per-day tax. Holding a position is free; churning
+                   it is not.
+
+See .claude/plans/transaction-costs.md for the full design.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+@dataclass
+class CostModel:
+    """Configuration for one backtest's cost accounting.
+
+    Attributes:
+        mode: "none" | "flat" | "realistic".
+        flat_bps: Legacy flat per-day haircut used by mode="flat" — this is
+            exactly the pre-existing ``trade_cost_bps`` knob.
+        commission_bps: Flat commission per trade, in bps of notional.
+            Defaults to 0 (Robinhood-style commission-free execution).
+        half_spread_bps: Flat bid-ask spread cost per trade (one-way), bps.
+        impact_coeff_bps: Square-root market-impact coefficient, bps.
+        fallback_adv: Dollar volume assumed when a ticker's average dollar
+            volume is unavailable (missing/zero Volume data) — conservative
+            (small), so a missing liquidity estimate never understates cost.
+    """
+
+    mode: str = "flat"
+    flat_bps: float = 1.0
+    commission_bps: float = 0.0
+    half_spread_bps: float = 2.5
+    impact_coeff_bps: float = 30.0
+    fallback_adv: float = 1_000_000.0
+
+
+def adv_dollars(df: pd.DataFrame, window: int = 20) -> pd.Series:
+    """Rolling average dollar volume (Volume × Close), min_periods=5.
+
+    Returns an all-NaN series (same index) if the frame has no Volume
+    column — callers fall back to ``CostModel.fallback_adv`` per-value.
+    """
+    if "Volume" not in df.columns:
+        return pd.Series(index=df.index, dtype=float)
+    dollar_vol = df["Volume"].astype(float) * df["Close"].astype(float)
+    return dollar_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=5).mean()
+
+
+def one_way_cost_bps(model: CostModel, trade_notional: float, adv: float | None) -> float:
+    """Commission + half-spread + square-root market-impact, in bps of notional.
+
+    A zero-size trade still pays commission + spread (the fixed cost of
+    crossing the market at all) but no impact term. Impact scales with the
+    square root of participation (trade notional / average dollar volume) —
+    doubling size costs ~41% more, not 100% more, matching observed market
+    behavior (Almgren et al.).
+    """
+    base = model.commission_bps + model.half_spread_bps
+    if trade_notional <= 0:
+        return base
+    a = adv if (adv is not None and adv > 0) else model.fallback_adv
+    participation = trade_notional / a
+    impact = model.impact_coeff_bps * math.sqrt(max(participation, 0.0))
+    return base + impact
+
+
+def day_cost(model: CostModel, equity: float, weight_changes: dict,
+            had_position: bool) -> float:
+    """Total dollar cost for one day, dispatching on ``model.mode``.
+
+    Args:
+        model: The active cost model.
+        equity: Equity basis for sizing trade notional. Callers pass the
+            PRE-return equity for "realistic" (you trade before knowing the
+            day's return) and the POST-return equity for "flat" (matches
+            the exact legacy formula ``equity *= (1+ret); equity *= (1-cost)``).
+        weight_changes: {ticker: (delta_weight, adv_dollars_or_None)} — the
+            signed target-weight change for each ticker touched today
+            (entries, exits, and direction flips all show up here).
+            Ignored for "none" and "flat".
+        had_position: Whether the portfolio held anything today. Ignored
+            for "none" and "realistic" (which key off actual weight deltas).
+
+    Returns:
+        Non-negative dollar cost.
+    """
+    if model.mode == "none":
+        return 0.0
+    if model.mode == "flat":
+        return equity * (model.flat_bps / 10000.0) if had_position else 0.0
+    total = 0.0
+    for dw, adv in weight_changes.values():
+        notional = abs(dw) * equity
+        if notional <= 0:
+            continue
+        bps = one_way_cost_bps(model, notional, adv)
+        total += notional * (bps / 10000.0)
+    return total

+"""Tests for costs.py — the shared transaction cost & slippage model."""
+import math
+
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+
+from costs import CostModel, adv_dollars, day_cost, one_way_cost_bps
+
+
+def test_one_way_cost_zero_notional_is_commission_plus_spread_only():
+    """A zero-size trade still pays the fixed cost of crossing the market."""
+    model = CostModel(commission_bps=1.0, half_spread_bps=2.5, impact_coeff_bps=30.0)
+    assert one_way_cost_bps(model, 0.0, adv=1_000_000.0) == pytest.approx(3.5)
+
+
+def test_impact_scales_as_square_root_of_participation():
+    """Quadrupling trade notional exactly doubles the impact term (sqrt(4)=2)."""
+    model = CostModel(commission_bps=0.0, half_spread_bps=0.0, impact_coeff_bps=30.0)
+    small = one_way_cost_bps(model, trade_notional=10_000, adv=1_000_000)
+    big = one_way_cost_bps(model, trade_notional=40_000, adv=1_000_000)
+    assert big == pytest.approx(2 * small)
+
+
+def test_missing_adv_falls_back_to_conservative_default():
+    """No ADV data -> use fallback_adv, never crash, never divide by zero."""
+    model = CostModel(fallback_adv=500_000.0, impact_coeff_bps=30.0,
+                      commission_bps=0.0, half_spread_bps=0.0)
+    bps = one_way_cost_bps(model, trade_notional=50_000, adv=None)
+    expected = 30.0 * math.sqrt(50_000 / 500_000)
+    assert bps == pytest.approx(expected)
+
+
+def test_adv_dollars_no_volume_column_returns_all_nan_series():
+    """A frame without Volume degrades to an all-NaN ADV series, not a crash."""
+    df = pd.DataFrame({"Close": [10.0, 11.0, 12.0]}, index=pd.bdate_range("2024-01-02", periods=3))
+    adv = adv_dollars(df)
+    assert adv.isna().all()
+
+
+def test_adv_dollars_computes_rolling_dollar_volume():
+    """ADV is Volume * Close, rolled — check a fully-warmed-up window."""
+    idx = pd.bdate_range("2024-01-02", periods=25)
+    df = pd.DataFrame({"Close": [10.0] * 25, "Volume": [1000.0] * 25}, index=idx)
+    adv = adv_dollars(df, window=20)
+    assert adv.iloc[-1] == pytest.approx(10.0 * 1000.0)
+    assert adv.iloc[:4].isna().all()  # min_periods=5
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# day_cost: mode dispatch
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def test_day_cost_none_mode_is_always_zero():
+    model = CostModel(mode="none")
+    assert day_cost(model, equity=100_000, weight_changes={"A": (0.5, 1e6)}, had_position=True) == 0.0
+
+
+def test_day_cost_flat_mode_matches_legacy_formula():
+    """flat mode: equity * flat_bps/10000 when there's any position, else 0."""
+    model = CostModel(mode="flat", flat_bps=1.0)
+    c = day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes={}, had_position=True)
+    assert c == pytest.approx(100_000.0 * 1.0 / 10000.0)
+    assert day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes={}, had_position=False) == 0.0
+
+
+def test_day_cost_realistic_mode_sums_per_ticker_costs():
+    """realistic mode charges each ticker's |Δweight| notional independently."""
+    model = CostModel(mode="realistic", commission_bps=0.0, half_spread_bps=10.0,
+                      impact_coeff_bps=0.0)  # isolate the flat spread component
+    weight_changes = {"A": (0.3, None), "B": (-0.2, None)}
+    c = day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes=weight_changes, had_position=True)
+    # each: notional * 10bps/10000 = notional * 0.001
+    expected = (0.3 * 100_000.0 * 0.001) + (0.2 * 100_000.0 * 0.001)
+    assert c == pytest.approx(expected)
+
+
+def test_day_cost_realistic_mode_zero_delta_is_free():
+    """Holding (Δweight=0) costs nothing under realistic mode — only churn pays."""
+    model = CostModel(mode="realistic", half_spread_bps=10.0, impact_coeff_bps=30.0)
+    c = day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes={"A": (0.0, 1e6)}, had_position=True)
+    assert c == 0.0
+
+
+def test_day_cost_realistic_mode_less_liquid_ticker_costs_more():
+    """Same trade size, lower ADV -> higher cost (more market impact)."""
+    model = CostModel(mode="realistic", commission_bps=0.0, half_spread_bps=0.0,
+                      impact_coeff_bps=30.0)
+    liquid = day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes={"A": (0.1, 10_000_000.0)}, had_position=True)
+    illiquid = day_cost(model, equity=100_000.0, weight_changes={"A": (0.1, 100_000.0)}, had_position=True)
+    assert illiquid > liquid

+"""Transaction cost & slippage model shared by all three backtest loops.
+
+Three modes, selected via ``CostModel.mode``:
+  - "none"       — zero cost. ``equity == equity_gross`` always.
+  - "flat"       — today's legacy behavior: a flat per-day haircut applied
+                   whenever the portfolio holds any position, independent of
+                   how much actually turned over. Kept so every existing
+                   backtest result stays reproducible bit-for-bit; this is
+                   the default mode everywhere.
+  - "realistic"  — commission + half bid-ask spread + square-root market
+                   impact, charged on TURNOVER (|Δweight| × equity), not a
+                   flat per-day tax. Holding a position is free; churning
+                   it is not.
+
+See .claude/plans/transaction-costs.md for the full design.

+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass

+import pandas as pd

+@dataclass
+class CostModel:
+    """Configuration for one backtest's cost accounting.
+
+    Attributes:
+        mode: "none" | "flat" | "realistic".
+        flat_bps: Legacy flat per-day haircut used by mode="flat" — this is
+            exactly the pre-existing ``trade_cost_bps`` knob.
+        commission_bps: Flat commission per trade, in bps of notional.
+            Defaults to 0 (Robinhood-style commission-free execution).
+        half_spread_bps: Flat bid-ask spread cost per trade (one-way), bps.
+        impact_coeff_bps: Square-root market-impact coefficient, bps.
+        fallback_adv: Dollar volume assumed when a ticker's average dollar
+            volume is unavailable (missing/zero Volume data) — conservative
+            (small), so a missing liquidity estimate never understates cost.
+    """
+
+    mode: str = "flat"
+    flat_bps: float = 1.0
+    commission_bps: float = 0.0
+    half_spread_bps: float = 2.5
+    impact_coeff_bps: float = 30.0
+    fallback_adv: float = 1_000_000.0
+

+def adv_dollars(df: pd.DataFrame, window: int = 20) -> pd.Series:
+    """Rolling average dollar volume (Volume × Close), min_periods=5.
+
+    Returns an all-NaN series (same index) if the frame has no Volume
+    column — callers fall back to ``CostModel.fallback_adv`` per-value.
+    """
+    if "Volume" not in df.columns:
+        return pd.Series(index=df.index, dtype=float)
+    dollar_vol = df["Volume"].astype(float) * df["Close"].astype(float)
+    return dollar_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=5).mean()
+

+def one_way_cost_bps(model: CostModel, trade_notional: float, adv: float | None) -> float:
+    """Commission + half-spread + square-root market-impact, in bps of notional.
+
+    A zero-size trade still pays commission + spread (the fixed cost of
+    crossing the market at all) but no impact term. Impact scales with the
+    square root of participation (trade notional / average dollar volume) —
+    doubling size costs ~41% more, not 100% more, matching observed market
+    behavior (Almgren et al.).
+    """
+    base = model.commission_bps + model.half_spread_bps
+    if trade_notional <= 0:
+        return base
+    a = adv if (adv is not None and adv > 0) else model.fallback_adv
+    participation = trade_notional / a
+    impact = model.impact_coeff_bps * math.sqrt(max(participation, 0.0))
+    return base + impact
+

+def day_cost(model: CostModel, equity: float, weight_changes: dict,
+            had_position: bool) -> float:
+    """Total dollar cost for one day, dispatching on ``model.mode``.
+
+    Args:
+        model: The active cost model.
+        equity: Equity basis for sizing trade notional. Callers pass the
+            PRE-return equity for "realistic" (you trade before knowing the
+            day's return) and the POST-return equity for "flat" (matches
+            the exact legacy formula ``equity *= (1+ret); equity *= (1-cost)``).
+        weight_changes: {ticker: (delta_weight, adv_dollars_or_None)} — the
+            signed target-weight change for each ticker touched today

+        had_position: Whether the portfolio held anything today. Ignored
+            for "none" and "realistic" (which key off actual weight deltas).

+    Returns:

+    if model.mode == "flat":

+        notional = abs(dw) * equity

+        total += notional * (bps / 10000.0)

"""Transaction cost & slippage model shared by all three backtest loops.

Three modes, selected via ``CostModel.mode``:
  - "none"       — zero cost. ``equity == equity_gross`` always.
  - "flat"       — today's legacy behavior: a flat per-day haircut applied
                   whenever the portfolio holds any position, independent of
                   how much actually turned over. Kept so every existing
                   backtest result stays reproducible bit-for-bit; this is
                   the default mode everywhere.
  - "realistic"  — commission + half bid-ask spread + square-root market
                   impact, charged on TURNOVER (|Δweight| × equity), not a
                   flat per-day tax. Holding a position is free; churning
                   it is not.

See .claude/plans/transaction-costs.md for the full design.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import pandas as pd


@dataclass
class CostModel:
    """Configuration for one backtest's cost accounting.

    Attributes:
        mode: "none" | "flat" | "realistic".
        flat_bps: Legacy flat per-day haircut used by mode="flat" — this is
            exactly the pre-existing ``trade_cost_bps`` knob.
        commission_bps: Flat commission per trade, in bps of notional.
            Defaults to 0 (Robinhood-style commission-free execution).
        half_spread_bps: Flat bid-ask spread cost per trade (one-way), bps.
        impact_coeff_bps: Square-root market-impact coefficient, bps.
        fallback_adv: Dollar volume assumed when a ticker's average dollar
            volume is unavailable (missing/zero Volume data) — conservative
            (small), so a missing liquidity estimate never understates cost.
    """

    mode: str = "flat"
    flat_bps: float = 1.0
    commission_bps: float = 0.0
    half_spread_bps: float = 2.5
    impact_coeff_bps: float = 30.0
    fallback_adv: float = 1_000_000.0


def adv_dollars(df: pd.DataFrame, window: int = 20) -> pd.Series:
    """Rolling average dollar volume (Volume × Close), min_periods=5.

    Returns an all-NaN series (same index) if the frame has no Volume
    column — callers fall back to ``CostModel.fallback_adv`` per-value.
    """
    if "Volume" not in df.columns:
        return pd.Series(index=df.index, dtype=float)
    dollar_vol = df["Volume"].astype(float) * df["Close"].astype(float)
    return dollar_vol.rolling(window, min_periods=5).mean()


def one_way_cost_bps(model: CostModel, trade_notional: float, adv: float | None) -> float:
    """Commission + half-spread + square-root market-impact, in bps of notional.

    A zero-size trade still pays commission + spread (the fixed cost of
    crossing the market at all) but no impact term. Impact scales with the
    square root of participation (trade notional / average dollar volume) —
    doubling size costs ~41% more, not 100% more, matching observed market
    behavior (Almgren et al.).
    """
    base = model.commission_bps + model.half_spread_bps
    if trade_notional <= 0:
        return base
    a = adv if (adv is not None and adv > 0) else model.fallback_adv
    participation = trade_notional / a
    impact = model.impact_coeff_bps * math.sqrt(max(participation, 0.0))
    return base + impact


def day_cost(model: CostModel, equity: float, weight_changes: dict,
            had_position: bool) -> float:
    """Total dollar cost for one day, dispatching on ``model.mode``.

    Args:
        model: The active cost model.
        equity: Equity basis for sizing trade notional. Callers pass the
            PRE-return equity for "realistic" (you trade before knowing the
            day's return) and the POST-return equity for "flat" (matches
            the exact legacy formula ``equity *= (1+ret); equity *= (1-cost)``).
        weight_changes: {ticker: (delta_weight, adv_dollars_or_None)} — the
            signed target-weight change for each ticker touched today
            (entries, exits, and direction flips all show up here).
            Ignored for "none" and "flat".
        had_position: Whether the portfolio held anything today. Ignored
            for "none" and "realistic" (which key off actual weight deltas).

    Returns:
        Non-negative dollar cost.
    """
    if model.mode == "none":
        return 0.0
    if model.mode == "flat":
        return equity * (model.flat_bps / 10000.0) if had_position else 0.0
    total = 0.0
    for dw, adv in weight_changes.values():
        notional = abs(dw) * equity
        if notional <= 0:
            continue
        bps = one_way_cost_bps(model, notional, adv)
        total += notional * (bps / 10000.0)
    return total

def run_strategy_walkforward(strategy,
                             data: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
                             top_n: int = 5,
                             capital: float = 100000.0,
                             trade_cost_bps: float = 1.0,
                             sizing: str = "equal",
                             max_pos: float = 0.30,
                             vol_window: int = 20,
                             cost_model: CostModel | None = None) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Backtest any DailyStrategy over pre-fetched daily OHLCV frames.

    Generic counterpart to ``simulate_walkforward`` (which is GBM-specific):
    on each date, every ticker's history up to and including that bar is
    handed to ``strategy.generate_signal``; the ``top_n`` non-hold signals
    ranked by confidence are held for one bar, realizing the next
    close-to-close return (signed by position). Each ticker's final bar
    produces no trade — its forward return does not exist yet.

    Data is injected rather than fetched so tests stay offline and the
    arena's live loop can reuse the same code path (backfill == backtest).

    Args:
        strategy: A ``strategies.daily.DailyStrategy`` instance.
        data: ``{ticker: OHLCV DataFrame}`` as returned by ``fetch_history``.
        top_n: Maximum concurrent positions per day.
        capital: Starting equity.
        trade_cost_bps: Flat cost applied on each day with any position.
        sizing: "equal" (today's behavior — split evenly across picks) or
            "conf_vol" (confidence / rolling volatility, capped at
            ``max_pos``, with any capacity the cap can't fill left in cash).
        max_pos: Per-position cap for "conf_vol" sizing. Ignored otherwise.
        vol_window: Rolling window (days) for the "conf_vol" volatility
            estimate. Ignored otherwise.
        cost_model: A ``costs.CostModel``. Defaults to
            ``CostModel(mode="flat", flat_bps=trade_cost_bps)`` — omitting
            this argument reproduces the pre-cost-model behavior exactly.

    Returns:
        (equity_df, blotter_df): equity_df is indexed by date with columns
        equity (net) / equity_gross / cost / n_picks / realized (every date
        with data gets a row, so strategies are comparable on equal-length
        series); blotter_df has one row per (date, ticker) position taken,
        with its sized weight.
    """
    model = cost_model if cost_model is not None else CostModel(mode="flat", flat_bps=trade_cost_bps)
    frames = {t: df.sort_index() for t, df in data.items()
              if "Close" in df.columns and not df.empty}
    fwd = {t: df["Close"].pct_change().shift(-1) for t, df in frames.items()}
    vol = {}
    if sizing == "conf_vol":
        vol = {t: df["Close"].pct_change().rolling(vol_window, min_periods=max(2, vol_window // 2)).std()
               for t, df in frames.items()}
    adv = {}
    if model.mode == "realistic":
        adv = {t: adv_dollars(df) for t, df in frames.items()}
    all_dates = sorted(set().union(*[set(df.index) for df in frames.values()])) if frames else []

    equity = capital
    equity_gross = capital
    prev_signed_weights: Dict[str, float] = {}
    daily = []
    blotter_rows = []
    for dt in all_dates:
        candidates = []
        for t, df in frames.items():
            if dt not in df.index:
                continue
            hist = df.loc[:dt]
            if len(hist) < strategy.warmup_bars:
                continue
            fwd_ret = fwd[t].loc[dt]
            if pd.isna(fwd_ret):
                continue  # ticker's last bar: outcome unknown until the next bar
            sig = strategy.generate_signal(hist)
            if sig.position == 0:
                continue
            candidates.append((t, sig, float(fwd_ret)))

        picks = []
        realized = 0.0
        weights: Dict[str, float] = {}
        if candidates:
            candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c[1].confidence, reverse=True)
            picks = candidates[:top_n]
            if sizing == "conf_vol":
                vols_today = {t: (vol[t].loc[dt] if dt in vol[t].index else None) for t, _, _ in picks}
                weights = _conf_vol_weights(picks, vols_today, max_pos)
            else:
                weights = {t: 1.0 / len(picks) for t, _, _ in picks}
            realized = sum(weights.get(t, 0.0) * sig.position * fwd_ret for t, sig, fwd_ret in picks)
            for t, sig, fwd_ret in picks:
                blotter_rows.append({"date": dt, "ticker": t, "position": sig.position,
                                     "confidence": sig.confidence, "weight": weights.get(t, 0.0),
                                     "fwd_ret": fwd_ret, "reason": sig.reason})

        equity_gross *= (1 + realized)

        signed_weights = {t: weights[t] * sig.position for t, sig, _ in picks}
        if model.mode == "flat":
            equity_after_return = equity * (1 + realized)
            c = day_cost(model, equity_after_return, {}, had_position=bool(picks))
            equity = equity_after_return - c
        elif model.mode == "none":
            equity *= (1 + realized)
            c = 0.0
        else:  # realistic — turnover priced on the PRE-return equity basis.
            # A no-pick day (a real HOLD, or simply a ticker's final bar with
            # no forward return to evaluate) is "no rebalance today", not a
            # forced exit: prev_signed_weights carries forward unchanged and
            # nothing is charged. Known simplification — a HOLD gap followed
            # by re-entry at the same weight is not charged a fresh entry,
            # since this backtest has no intraday-exit mechanism to model
            # what happens during the gap.
            if picks:
                all_tickers = set(prev_signed_weights) | set(signed_weights)
                weight_changes = {
                    t: (signed_weights.get(t, 0.0) - prev_signed_weights.get(t, 0.0),
                        (adv[t].loc[dt] if t in adv and dt in adv[t].index else None))
                    for t in all_tickers
                }
                c = day_cost(model, equity, weight_changes, had_position=True)
                prev_signed_weights = signed_weights
            else:
                c = 0.0
            equity = equity * (1 + realized) - c

        daily.append({"date": dt, "equity": equity, "equity_gross": equity_gross,
                      "cost": c, "n_picks": len(picks), "realized": realized})

    if daily:
        equity_df = pd.DataFrame(daily).set_index("date")
    else:
        equity_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["equity", "equity_gross", "cost", "n_picks", "realized"])
    return equity_df, pd.DataFrame(blotter_rows)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strategy Arena orchestrator (entry point: arena-run).

Runs multiple DailyStrategy implementations through one pipeline:

  arena-run backtest  — walk-forward every selected strategy over the same
                        window, apply the universal filter bar (lenient by
                        design: it screens out clear losers only), persist
                        PASS/EXCLUDED with metrics. Excluded strategies stay
                        visible in the report — never silently dropped.
  arena-run live      — one paper-trading tick per surviving strategy:
                        recompute signals over recent history and append any
                        equity/trade rows newer than the last recorded date.
                        Deterministic strategies + INSERT OR IGNORE make this
                        idempotent and self-backfilling after missed days.
  arena-run report    — side-by-side comparison table, unranked.

State lives in SQLite (stdlib sqlite3 — no new dependency) under
arena_state/arena.db by default. Each strategy has its own independent
paper ledger; there is no shared capital pool.

See .claude/plans/strategy-arena.md for the full design.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import os
import sqlite3
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

import pandas as pd

from analyze_equity import compute_metrics
from costs import CostModel
from strategies.daily import DailyStrategy
from strategies.registry import available_strategies, get_strategy
from walkforward_sim import parse_tickers, run_strategy_walkforward

DEFAULT_DB = os.path.join("arena_state", "arena.db")

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strategies (
  name            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status          TEXT NOT NULL,            -- PASS | EXCLUDED
  backtest_sharpe REAL,
  backtest_cagr   REAL,
  backtest_maxdd  REAL,
  updated         TEXT
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equity (
  strategy TEXT NOT NULL,
  date     TEXT NOT NULL,
  equity   REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trades (
  strategy   TEXT NOT NULL,
  date       TEXT NOT NULL,
  ticker     TEXT NOT NULL,
  position   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL,
  weight     REAL,
  fwd_ret    REAL,
  reason     TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date, ticker)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gaps (
  strategy TEXT NOT NULL,
  date     TEXT NOT NULL,
  cause    TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (strategy, date)
);
"""


def _iso(d) -> str:
    """Normalize a pandas Timestamp / datetime / date to YYYY-MM-DD."""
    return pd.Timestamp(d).date().isoformat()


def _ensure_column(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, column: str, ddl: str) -> None:
    """Idempotently add a column to an existing table (in-place migration).

    ``CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`` only helps brand-new databases — an
    arena.db created before a schema change needs its own ALTER. Guarded on
    PRAGMA table_info so re-running is always safe.
    """
    cols = {row[1] for row in conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")}
    if column not in cols:
        conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {ddl}")
        conn.commit()


class ArenaState:
    """SQLite persistence for the arena's backtest verdicts and live ledgers."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        parent = os.path.dirname(db_path)
        if parent:
            os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        self.conn.executescript(_SCHEMA)
        self.conn.commit()
        _ensure_column(self.conn, "strategies", "sizing", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equal'")

    def record_backtest(self, name: str, status: str, metrics: dict,
                        sizing: str = "equal") -> None:
        """Upsert a strategy's filter verdict, backtest metrics, and sizing mode.

        Sizing is screened configuration: whatever mode a strategy is
        screened under is what ``arena-run live`` reuses for it — a live
        track record never silently switches sizing regimes mid-stream.
        """
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO strategies(name,status,backtest_sharpe,backtest_cagr,backtest_maxdd,sizing,updated) "
            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,date('now')) "
            "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status, "
            "backtest_sharpe=excluded.backtest_sharpe, backtest_cagr=excluded.backtest_cagr, "
            "backtest_maxdd=excluded.backtest_maxdd, sizing=excluded.sizing, updated=excluded.updated",
            (name, status, metrics.get("Sharpe"), metrics.get("CAGR"), metrics.get("MaxDD"), sizing),
        )
        self.conn.commit()

    def statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
        """{strategy name: PASS | EXCLUDED} for every strategy seen in backtest."""
        return dict(self.conn.execute("SELECT name, status FROM strategies"))

    def sizing_mode(self, name: str) -> str:
        """Stored sizing mode for a strategy; 'equal' if never screened (legacy)."""
        row = self.conn.execute("SELECT sizing FROM strategies WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row and row[0] else "equal"

    def last_equity(self, name: str) -> Tuple[str, float] | None:
        """(date, equity) of the newest recorded live bar, or None if fresh."""
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT date, equity FROM equity WHERE strategy=? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (name,),
        ).fetchone()
        return (row[0], float(row[1])) if row else None

    def append_ledger(self, name: str, equity_rows: List[tuple],
                      trade_rows: List[tuple]) -> int:
        """Idempotently append (date, equity) and trade rows; returns rows added."""
        cur = self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO equity(strategy,date,equity) VALUES(?,?,?)",
            [(name, d, e) for d, e in equity_rows],
        )
        added = cur.rowcount
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO trades(strategy,date,ticker,position,confidence,weight,fwd_ret,reason) "
            "VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            [(name, *t) for t in trade_rows],
        )
        self.conn.commit()
        return added

    def log_gap(self, name: str, date: str, cause: str) -> None:
        """Record a skipped strategy-day (data failure etc.) without crashing the run."""
        self.conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gaps(strategy,date,cause) VALUES(?,?,?)",
                          (name, date, cause))
        self.conn.commit()


def passes_filter(metrics: dict, min_sharpe: float, max_dd: float) -> bool:
    """Universal (strategy-agnostic) backtest bar.

    Lenient by design — Sharpe must clear min_sharpe and max drawdown must
    stay above max_dd (both defaults screen out only clear losers; the live
    arena does the real comparison).
    """
    sharpe = metrics.get("Sharpe")
    maxdd = metrics.get("MaxDD")
    if sharpe is None or maxdd is None:
        return False
    return sharpe > min_sharpe and maxdd >= max_dd


def build_strategy(name: str, gbm_bundle: str | None) -> DailyStrategy:
    """Construct a registered strategy, wiring the GBM bundle path when needed."""
    if name == "gbm":
        if not gbm_bundle:
            raise SystemExit("strategy 'gbm' requires --gbm_bundle <model_bundle.joblib>")
        return get_strategy(name, bundle_path=gbm_bundle)
    return get_strategy(name)


def live_tick(state: ArenaState, name: str, strategy: DailyStrategy,
              data: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame], top_n: int, capital: float,
              trade_cost_bps: float, sizing: str = "equal",
              max_pos: float = 0.30, vol_window: int = 20,
              cost_model: CostModel | None = None) -> int:
    """One live paper-trading step for one strategy over pre-fetched data.

    Recomputes the walk-forward over the fetched window, then appends only
    rows newer than the last recorded date, chaining equity multiplicatively
    from the stored value. Because strategies are deterministic given data,
    a missed week self-heals on the next run, and re-running the same day is
    a no-op (PRIMARY KEY + INSERT OR IGNORE).

    ``sizing`` should be the mode the strategy was screened under
    (``ArenaState.sizing_mode``) — callers should not pick an arbitrary mode
    for a strategy already trading live.

    Returns the number of new equity rows appended.
    """
    eq, blotter = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=top_n,
                                           capital=capital,
                                           trade_cost_bps=trade_cost_bps,
                                           sizing=sizing, max_pos=max_pos,
                                           vol_window=vol_window,
                                           cost_model=cost_model)
    if eq.empty:
        state.log_gap(name, _iso(dt.date.today()), "no data in fetched window")
        return 0

    # The window's final bar is provisional: its own forward return doesn't
    # exist yet, so storing it now would permanently miss that return once
    # the next bar arrives. Drop it — the next run records it fully realized.
    eq = eq.iloc[:-1]
    if eq.empty:
        return 0

    # Per-bar growth factors are scale-free, so they chain onto any stored
    # equity regardless of what `capital` the recompute started from.
    factors = eq["equity"] / eq["equity"].shift(1)
    factors.iloc[0] = eq["equity"].iloc[0] / capital

    last = state.last_equity(name)
    if last is None:
        new = eq
        chained = eq["equity"]
    else:
        last_date, last_equity = last
        mask = eq.index > pd.Timestamp(last_date)
        new = eq[mask]
        if new.empty:
            return 0
        chained = factors[mask].cumprod() * last_equity

    equity_rows = [(_iso(d), float(v)) for d, v in chained.items()]
    new_dates = {_iso(d) for d in new.index}
    trade_rows = []
    if not blotter.empty:
        for _, r in blotter.iterrows():
            if _iso(r["date"]) in new_dates:
                trade_rows.append((_iso(r["date"]), r["ticker"], int(r["position"]),
                                   float(r["confidence"]), float(r["weight"]),
                                   float(r["fwd_ret"]), r["reason"]))
    return state.append_ledger(name, equity_rows, trade_rows)


def _parse_names(arg: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split and validate a comma-separated strategy list."""
    names = [s.strip() for s in arg.split(",") if s.strip()]
    unknown = [n for n in names if n not in available_strategies()]
    if unknown:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown strategies: {', '.join(unknown)} "
                         f"(available: {', '.join(available_strategies())})")
    return names


def _cost_model_from_args(args: argparse.Namespace) -> CostModel:
    """Build a CostModel from the shared --cost_model/--*_bps CLI flags."""
    return CostModel(mode=args.cost_model, flat_bps=args.trade_cost_bps,
                     commission_bps=args.commission_bps,
                     half_spread_bps=args.half_spread_bps,
                     impact_coeff_bps=args.impact_coeff_bps,
                     fallback_adv=args.fallback_adv)


def cmd_backtest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Backtest all selected strategies over one window and apply the filter."""
    from paper_trading_sim import fetch_history  # local: network-touching import

    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
    data = fetch_history(tickers, args.start, args.end)
    state = ArenaState(args.db)
    cost_model = _cost_model_from_args(args)
    rows = []
    for name in _parse_names(args.strategies):
        strategy = build_strategy(name, args.gbm_bundle)
        eq, _ = run_strategy_walkforward(strategy, data, top_n=args.top_n,
                                         capital=args.capital,
                                         sizing=args.sizing, max_pos=args.max_pos,
                                         vol_window=args.vol_window,
                                         cost_model=cost_model)
        metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity"]) if not eq.empty else {}
        gross_metrics = compute_metrics(eq["equity_gross"]) if not eq.empty else {}
        total_cost = float(eq["cost"].sum()) if not eq.empty else 0.0
        ok = passes_filter(metrics, args.min_sharpe, args.max_dd)
        status = "PASS" if ok else "EXCLUDED"
        state.record_backtest(name, status, metrics, sizing=args.sizing)
        rows.append({"strategy": name, "status": status,
                     "sharpe": metrics.get("Sharpe"), "cagr": metrics.get("CAGR"),
                     "maxdd": metrics.get("MaxDD")})
        print(f"{name:12s} {status:8s} sharpe={metrics.get('Sharpe', float('nan')):.2f} "
              f"cagr(net)={metrics.get('CAGR', float('nan')):.2%} "

def cmd_live(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    """Run one live paper-trading tick for every PASS strategy."""

    state = ArenaState(args.db)
    statuses = state.statuses()
    names = _parse_names(args.strategies) if args.strategies else \
        [n for n, s in statuses.items() if s == "PASS"]
    if not names:
        raise SystemExit("no PASS strategies in the arena DB — run `arena-run backtest` first")

    tickers = parse_tickers(args.tickers, args.tickers_file)
    start = (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=args.lookback_days)).isoformat()
    today = dt.date.today().isoformat()
    for name in names:
        if statuses.get(name) != "PASS":
            print(f"{name}: skipped (status={statuses.get(name, 'never backtested')})")
            continue

    common.add_argument("--half_spread_bps", type=float, default=2.5,

    common.add_argument("--impact_coeff_bps", type=float, default=30.0,
                        help="'realistic' mode: square-root market-impact coefficient, bps")
    common.add_argument("--fallback_adv", type=float, default=1_000_000.0,
                        help="'realistic' mode: assumed dollar volume when a ticker's is unavailable")

    b = sub.add_parser("backtest", parents=[common],

    b.add_argument("--start", type=str, required=True)

    b.add_argument("--min_sharpe", type=float, default=0.0,

    b.add_argument("--max_dd", type=float, default=-0.30,
                   help="universal filter: worst tolerated drawdown (negative)")
    b.add_argument("--sizing", type=str, default="conf_vol", choices=["equal", "conf_vol"],
                   help="position sizing mode — persisted per strategy; live reuses it, not overridable there")
    b.set_defaults(func=cmd_backtest)

                       help="one idempotent, self-backfilling paper-trading tick")
